question: In the United States, for Q4 2019 and Q4 2020, first select only those cities where total sales (with no promotions) rose by at least 20% from Q4 2019 to Q4 2020. Among these cities, rank products by their overall sales (still excluding promotions) in those quarters and take the top 20%. Then compute each top product’s share of total sales in Q4 2019 and Q4 2020 and calculate the difference in share from Q4 2019 to Q4 2020, returning the results in descending order of that share change.

WITH q4_2019_city_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        c.cust_city_id,
        c.cust_city,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) as q4_2019_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'United States of America'
        AND t.calendar_year = 2019
        AND t.calendar_quarter_number = 4
        AND s.promo_id IS NULL
    GROUP BY c.cust_city_id, c.cust_city
),
q4_2020_city_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        c.cust_city_id,
        c.cust_city,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) as q4_2020_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'United States of America'
        AND t.calendar_year = 2020
        AND t.calendar_quarter_number = 4
        AND s.promo_id IS NULL
    GROUP BY c.cust_city_id, c.cust_city
),
city_growth AS (
    SELECT 
        q4_2019.cust_city_id,
        q4_2019.cust_city,
        q4_2019.q4_2019_sales,
        q4_2020.q4_2020_sales,
        CASE 
            WHEN q4_2019.q4_2019_sales > 0 THEN q4_2020.q4_2020_sales * 1.0 / q4_2019.q4_2019_sales
            ELSE 0 
        END as growth_ratio
    FROM q4_2019_city_sales q4_2019
    LEFT JOIN q4_2020_city_sales q4_2020 ON q4_2019.cust_city_id = q4_2020.cust_city_id
    WHERE q4_2020.q4_2020_sales IS NOT NULL
),
qualifying_cities AS (
    SELECT 
        cust_city_id,
        cust_city,
        q4_2019_sales,
        q4_2020_sales,
        growth_ratio
    FROM city_growth
    WHERE growth_ratio >= 1.2
),
q4_2019_product_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        c.cust_city_id,
        c.cust_city,
        p.prod_id,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) as prod_q4_2019_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    JOIN products p ON s.prod_id = p.prod_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'United States of America'
        AND t.calendar_year = 2019
        AND t.calendar_quarter_number = 4
        AND s.promo_id IS NULL
        AND c.cust_city_id IN (SELECT cust_city_id FROM qualifying_cities)
    GROUP BY c.cust_city_id, c.cust_city, p.prod_id
),
q4_2020_product_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        c.cust_city_id,
        c.cust_city,
        p.prod_id,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) as prod_q4_2020_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    JOIN products p ON s.prod_id = p.prod_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'United States of America'
        AND t.calendar_year = 2020
        AND t.calendar_quarter_number = 4
        AND s.promo_id IS NULL
        AND c.cust_city_id IN (SELECT cust_city_id FROM qualifying_cities)
    GROUP BY c.cust_city_id, c.cust_city, p.prod_id
),
combined_product_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        q2019.cust_city_id,
        q2019.cust_city,
        q2019.prod_id,
        COALESCE(q2019.prod_q4_2019_sales, 0) as prod_q4_2019_sales,
        COALESCE(q2020.prod_q4_2020_sales, 0) as prod_q4_2020_sales,
        COALESCE(q2019.prod_q4_2019_sales, 0) + COALESCE(q2020.prod_q4_2020_sales, 0) as total_product_sales
    FROM q4_2019_product_sales q2019
    FULL OUTER JOIN q4_2020_product_sales q2020 ON q2019.cust_city_id = q2020.cust_city_id AND q2019.prod_id = q2020.prod_id
    WHERE NOT (q2019.prod_q4_2019_sales IS NULL AND q2020.prod_q4_2020_sales IS NULL)
),
city_total_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        cust_city_id,
        cust_city,
        SUM(prod_q4_2019_sales) as city_q4_2019_total,
        SUM(prod_q4_2020_sales) as city_q4_2020_total
    FROM combined_product_sales
    GROUP BY cust_city_id, cust_city
),
product_with_rank AS (
    SELECT 
        cust_city_id,
        cust_city,
        prod_id,
        prod_q4_2019_sales,
        prod_q4_2020_sales,
        total_product_sales,
        SUM(total_product_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY cust_city_id, cust_city) as city_total,
        NTILE(100) OVER (ORDER BY total_product_sales DESC) as percent_rank
    FROM combined_product_sales
),
top_20_percent_products AS (
    SELECT 
        cust_city_id,
        cust_city,
        prod_id,
        prod_q4_2019_sales,
        prod_q4_2020_sales,
        total_product_sales,
        city_total
    FROM product_with_rank
    WHERE percent_rank <= 20
),
product_shares AS (
    SELECT 
        t2019.cust_city_id,
        t2019.cust_city,
        t2019.prod_id,
        t2019.prod_q4_2019_sales,
        t2019.prod_q4_2020_sales,
        ROUND(t2019.prod_q4_2019_sales * 100.0 / cts.city_q4_2019_total, 4) as share_q4_2019,
        ROUND(t2019.prod_q4_2020_sales * 100.0 / cts.city_q4_2020_total, 4) as share_q4_2020,
        ROUND(t2019.prod_q4_2020_sales * 100.0 / cts.city_q4_2020_total - t2019.prod_q4_2019_sales * 100.0 / cts.city_q4_2019_total, 4) as share_change
    FROM top_20_percent_products t2019
    JOIN city_total_sales cts ON t2019.cust_city_id = cts.cust_city_id
)
SELECT 
    prod_id,
    share_q4_2019,
    share_q4_2020,
    share_change
FROM product_shares
ORDER BY share_change DESC
